none: PAS FindID 995993: Roman Coin: Tetrarchic Nummus
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Large module Tetrarchic nummus of an indeterminate later Roman ruler, possibly a Soli Invicto issue of 310-319, or perhaps a Genio Pop Rom; Reece period 15. Obverse description: Bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---]AVG. Reverse description: possibly Sol standing left. Reverse inscription: possibly [SOLI INVICTO COMITI]. Diameter: 26.5mm, Weight: 5.84gms, die axis: probably 6
